_doc: world/permits.md — v100 the paper layer: per-door permit walls (the framed paper behind the counter a camera can read) + door lineage (former tenants, ghost signs). Doors only. Agency names are civic facts (SFDPH, ABC, CDTFA, BAR, SFFD, Public Works) — they stay real per the naming rule; every business name in this file is parody or invented. Papers are conditions, never scripts; pending = an application receipt taped up, a readable state, never a drama beat.

paper_keys.business_license: SF Treasurer & Tax Collector — Business Registration Certificate
paper_keys.health_score: SFDPH — Food Facility Inspection Score Card
paper_keys.workers_notice: CA labor-law poster block (minimum wage, sick leave, workers' comp)
paper_keys.liquor_license: CA Dept. of Alcoholic Beverage Control — license type + conditions
paper_keys.entertainment: SF Entertainment Commission — Limited Live Performance permit
paper_keys.sidewalk_seating: SF Public Works — Tables & Chairs on the Sidewalk permit
paper_keys.food_handler: Food Handler Cards — staff on file behind the counter
paper_keys.weights: CA Weights & Measures — device seal on the scale
paper_keys.auto_repair: Bureau of Automotive Repair — registration placard

status_keys.posted: the default — framed or taped, current
status_keys.renewed: reissued this cycle — the date is fresh
status_keys.pending: application filed; the receipt is what's taped up — a readable state, not a violation

rules.doors_only: walls keys == anchor+street tier business ids, exactly — offstage orgs and reserved names carry no wall
rules.ghost_rule: ghost_sign is null or a string; a string requires at least one former entry — the wall remembers a tenant, not a rumor
rules.no_people: papers never name cast or regulars — 'staff on file' is the whole sentence
rules.no_money: no prices, no fees, no credit figures — the wall is framed paper, not a ledger
